feed.title: Virtual Assistant
feed.description: Newlane University is seeking a Virtual Assistant for Student and Faculty Support to provide reliable, detail-oriented administrative assistance in a fully remote role. Responsibilities include sending reminders to faculty for assessments, tracking student progress and engagement, assisting with onboarding and orientation processes, and ensuring accurate record-keeping. The ideal candidate is highly organized, thorough, and consistent in following protocols, with excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently. Experience in online education or student support is a plus. This role plays a key part in ensuring a smooth and supportive experience for both students and faculty.

pastJobsText.title: Video editor for instructional videos
pastJobsText.description: We are looking for a reliable Video Editor to help turn recorded lectures into clear, polished instructional videos. The role involves basic editing such as trimming pauses or mistakes, making simple audio or visual adjustments, and preparing videos for students to watch online. Responsibilities include editing provided lecture recordings, adding simple titles or transitions when needed, exporting videos in the correct format, and uploading and organizing videos on YouTube. The editor should be comfortable using YouTube Studio to add titles, descriptions, settings, and playlists as directed. Candidates should have basic experience with video editing software such as iMovie, Camtasia, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar tools. Advanced editing skills are not required, but the candidate should be comfortable with the fundamentals of editing, organizing files, following directions, and making lecture videos clear and easy to watch.

pastJobsText.title: College Intro to Psychology Course Intro Videos and Cohort
pastJobsText.description: Looking for an expert in Psychology to help host an Intro to Psychology cohort for an online Associate of Arts degree. And to prepare introductory videos for each lesson in the Introduction to Psychology course. Candidate must hold an advanced degree in Psychology, or similar discipline (prefer PhD), and be confident in their ability to develop or judge course structure and content for conventional undergraduate Intro to Psychology courses, and be able to assess in an oral exam, whether a student has mastered the course goals and objectives. The preferred candidate would bring lots of experience teaching Psychology at the college level. We are an exciting start up with a powerful platform to decentralize college. We'll have a good amount of curriculum development and assessment work available for the right candidate over the next few months.

pastJobsText.title: Course Reviewer for College Intro to Political Science Course
pastJobsText.description: Looking for an expert in Political Science to help review an Intro to Political Science for an online Associate of Arts degree. Review includes reviewing learning objectives, and assessments (including multiple choice questions and project prompts), and reviewing instructional resources. Candidate must hold an advanced degree in Political Science, or similar discipline (prefer PhD), and be confident in their ability to develop or judge course structure and content for conventional undergraduate Intro to Political Science courses. The preferred candidate would bring lots of experience teaching Political Science at the college level. We are an exciting start up with a powerful platform to decentralize college. We'll have a good amount of curriculum development work available for the right candidate over the next few months.
